workflow: An operation verifies that its backing resource is available and begins converting input through user-controlled callback code.
The callback closes or releases the backing resource while the outer operation is still in progress.
The outer operation fails to revalidate the resource after the callback returns.
A later native-resource access dereferences the cleared handle and terminates the process instead of reporting a recoverable state error.
summary: Re-entrant callback invalidates a backing resource before later use
